name: api_call
description:
Make an HTTP API call (GET or POST) to any REST API endpoint.

Use this when:
- User provides a specific API URL to call
- User asks to fetch data from a known web service or API
- User wants to check if an API endpoint is responding
- User needs to send data to an external service via POST

Do NOT use for:
- General web searches or browsing (use web search instead or native grounding search if enabled)
- Vague requests like "find information about X" without a specific API endpoint
- Authentication flows requiring OAuth or complex multi-step processes
